title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.29356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full cata

translated_title: 面向对话式产品搜索的波斯语电子商务对话数据集自动构建
translated_abstract: 对话式产品搜索让用户能够通过多轮对话而非单一关键词查询来查找产品，但波斯语缺乏训练和评估此类系统所需的大型对话数据集；现有的波斯语电子商务对话资源覆盖的类别少、商品目录规模小。我们提出了一个框架，可以从真实的电子商务目录中自动构建此类数据集，并发布了由此生成的数据集。该框架爬取了Digikala市场中七个类别的12,926个产品，将其归入170个语义连贯的聚类，并使用正则化分区平衡（RPB）分数来选择助手在每一轮提出的问题。RPB分数综合考虑了特征覆盖率、用户能够回答的概率以及取值数量，是对基于熵的问题选择方法的推广。随后，大语言模型（LLM）将每个问题规划转化为自然的波斯语对话。在完整目录上的模拟实验中……
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于正则化分区平衡（RPB）分数与LLM的自动化框架，从真实电商目录中自动构建并发布了覆盖7个类别、12,926个产品的大规模波斯语对话式产品搜索数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an automated framework based on the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score and LLMs to automatically construct and release a large-scale Persian conversational product search dialogue dataset covering 7 categories and 12,926 products from a real e-commerce catalog.
